convert_coco_text_to_detection_json: convert a COCO text annotation JSON file to COCO detection JSON format using extended_coco
filter_coco_annotations: filter and reject invalid COCO annotations like out-of-bbox or zero-area using convert_to_dict_list
load_extended_coco_with_copy_keys: load a COCO JSON dataset with optional direct copy keys preserved in loaded image dicts
register_keypoint_metadata: register custom keypoint metadata with names, flip maps, and connection rules via KEYPOINT_METADATA_REGISTRY
create_adhoc_class_subset_dataset: create an adhoc COCO dataset subset filtered to specific classes using AdhocDatasetManager and COCOWithClassesToUse
